body: A few weeks ago there was a lot of talk about old Chuck D, around the time of his birthday. I thought Ken Wilson had one of the most poignant and beautiful commentaries of all … really worth reading here. As I’ve said elsewhere, apologizing for the thousands of stupid and harmful things we Christians have done is an important part of apologetics. Why should anyone believe our message if we never admit when we’ve been … wrong? (You’ll find lots of other great stuff at Ken’s site too.)
